verdict.rationale: ELSTER has a sanctioned programmatic channel: any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit filings such as the Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung over the same rail, authenticated with the ELSTER certificate. Nothing shows parity with the Mein ELSTER UI, though. Receipt upload to "Meine Belege", electronic Vollmachten, Postfach access, e-invoice submission and viewing, the Steuernummer questionnaire, and retrieving Bescheide are all described only as portal or app features. A dated probe also found the public ERiC developer-artifact host unreachable for a keyless client. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of the UI-only features (Belege, Postfach, Vollmachten, e-invoices, registration questionnaires, Bescheid retrieval), a public API reference, and reliable developer-artifact access.
